instruction: Enhance the image quality to reveal the invisible ultraviolet patterns on the heron's feathers.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because the photograph was taken with a standard camera that only captures visible light wavelengths. Ultraviolet patterns are outside the visible spectrum and would require specialized UV photography equipment. No amount of image enhancement in GIMP can reveal wavelengths that were never captured by the camera sensor.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly identified as physically impossible - UV patterns cannot be revealed from visible-light photographs
The 'infeasible' evaluator function is the appropriate placeholder for tasks that cannot be completed
The metadata explanation is scientifically accurate and clearly explains why the task is impossible
No verification logic is needed because the task itself cannot be executed
The evaluator correctly indicates there is no way to verify completion of an impossible task
